text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! I can just picture my sisters' smiling faces!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You were thinking of me as well?!

text_block_list.text: Hehe, well, the thought alone is plenty for me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'd better ship these off to my sisters! Don't worry, I'll tell them you were the one who won them!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure they'll want to thank you, so have a little chat with them when they do! Thanks!
